mapper.sql: id, task_id, goal, session_id, workflow_context_json, status, operator_id, operator_name, max_steps, completed_steps, current_step_order, pending_audit_id, terminal_code, terminal_reason, lease_owner, claimed_at, heartbeat_at, cancelled_by, cancel_reason, cancelled_at, completed_at, created_time, updated_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_agent_task ( task_id, goal, session_id, workflow_context_json, status, operator_id, operator_name, max_steps, completed_steps, current_step_order, pending_audit_id, terminal_code, terminal_reason, lease_owner, claimed_at, heartbeat_at, cancelled_by, cancel_reason, cancelled_at, completed_at, created_time, updated_time ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{goal}, #{sessionId}, #{workflowContextJson}, #{status}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{maxSteps}, #{completedSteps}, #{currentStepOrder}, #{pendingAuditId}, #{terminalCode}, #{terminalReason}, #{leaseOwner}, #{claimedAt}, #{heartbeatAt}, #{cancelledBy}, #{cancelReason}, #{cancelledAt}, #{completedAt}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_agent_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1
SELECT task_id FROM sys_agent_task WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY created_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_agent_task SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, claimed_at = #{claimedAt}, heartbeat_at = #{claimedAt}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE sys_agent_task SET status = #{status}, workflow_context_json = #{workflowContextJson}, completed_steps = #{completedSteps}, current_step_order = #{currentStepOrder}, pending_audit_id = #{pendingAuditId}, terminal_code = #{terminalCode}, terminal_reason = #{terminalReason}, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, claimed_at = #{claimedAt}, heartbeat_at = #{heartbeatAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_time = #{updatedTime} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
AND lease_owner = #{expectedLeaseOwner}

UPDATE sys_agent_task SET status = #{task.status}, workflow_context_json = #{task.workflowContextJson}, completed_steps = #{task.completedSteps}, current_step_order = #{task.currentStepOrder}, pending_audit_id = #{task.pendingAuditId}, terminal_code = #{task.terminalCode}, terminal_reason = #{task.terminalReason}, lease_owner = #{task.leaseOwner}, claimed_at = #{task.claimedAt}, heartbeat_at = #{task.heartbeatAt}, completed_at = #{task.completedAt}, updated_time = #{task.updatedTime} WHERE task_id = #{task.taskId} AND status = #{task.expectedStatus} AND lease_owner = #{task.expectedLeaseOwner} AND COALESCE(heartbeat_at, claimed_at, updated_time) <= #{staleBefore}
